component.title: FilePreview
component.purpose: Summarize a file safely with typed status, metadata, and explicit actions.

states.description: A ready attachment with open, download, and remove actions.
A preview being prepared with a non-color status cue.
A typed fallback explaining why a preview is unavailable.

responsive.mobile: Metadata remains readable while actions become full-width controls below the file summary.

keyboard: Actions are native buttons with visible focus
Status is announced as status or alert
semantics: The file name is preserved as a title for truncated text
Error status does not rely on color alone

reducedMotion: Loading pulse is disabled when reduced motion is preferred.
